-- server/timeline/schema.sql

-- Make sure schema exists
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ehr;

-- Main timeline table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ehr.patient_timeline (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    structured JSONB,
    text TEXT,
    embedding VECTOR(1536),
    meta JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    -- NOTE: meta is a JSONB column used for auxiliary metadata.
    -- A canonical, but NOT DB-enforced, provenance contract is
    -- defined under the nested object meta->'provenance'. This
    -- comment block documents the expected shape for NEW writes;
    -- legacy rows without provenance remain valid and MUST continue
    -- to be accepted by all readers and writers.
    --
    -- This comment is intended to stay in sync with the database
    -- schema in database/schemas/ehr_timeline.sql. When updating the
    -- provenance contract, update both files together. The Python
    -- canonical representation and helpers live in
    -- server/timeline/provenance.py and MUST remain consistent with
    -- this documentation.
    --
    -- Canonical meta.provenance schema for ehr.patient_timeline
    -- ---------------------------------------------------------
    --   meta JSONB (opaque, application-defined JSON)
    --   └─ provenance JSONB OBJECT with the following fields:
    --
    --   Required provenance fields for NEW writes
    --   (writers SHOULD populate all of these; readers MUST be
    --   tolerant of missing fields, especially for legacy rows):
    --
    --     - source_system: TEXT
    --         High-level system of origin for the event, typically a
    --         stable, enum-like identifier such as "ehr", "notes",
    --         "llm", "etl", or a specific connector name. This is
    --         intended to be coarse-grained and stable over time.
    --
    --     - source_table: TEXT
    --         Name or logical identifier of the upstream table,
    --         collection, or feed from which this event was derived
    --         (e.g., "encounters", "notes", "labs_raw"). This is
    --         primarily for traceability and debugging.
    --
    --     - ingest_pipeline: TEXT
    --         Identifier of the ingest or processing pipeline that
    --         produced this event. Examples include a module or job
    --         name plus version, or a DAG/task identifier (e.g.,
    --         "etl.ehr.v1", "notes.ingest.batch@2024-10-01",
    --         "api.timeline.append.v2"). This is intended to help
    --         trace how the row entered the system.
    --
    --     - writer_version: TEXT
    --         Version string for the writer or pipeline component that
    --         produced this event (e.g., a semver like "1.2.3" or a
    --         git SHA). This allows readers to reason about behavior
    --         changes across versions.
    --
    --     - original_id: TEXT
    --         Identifier of the upstream record or object from which
    --         this timeline event was derived (e.g., a source-system
    --         encounter ID, note ID, lab result ID). This should be
    --         stable within the source_system/source_table pair.
    --
    --     - created_at: TEXT (ISO 8601 timestamp)
    --         Timestamp when this specific event representation was
    --         created by the ingest or processing pipeline. This is
    --         distinct from the clinical event time (ts column). It
    --         should be stored as an ISO 8601 string with timezone,
    --         e.g., "2025-12-17T20:25:26.406538+00:00".
    --
    --     - updated_at: TEXT (ISO 8601 timestamp)
    --         Timestamp of the last time this event representation was
    --         modified by a writer or pipeline. For immutable events,
    --         writers MAY set updated_at equal to created_at.
    --
    --   Optional provenance fields (MAY be present; readers MUST be
    --   tolerant of their absence):
    --
    --     - run_id: TEXT
    --         Identifier for the pipeline run, job, or request that
    --         produced this event (e.g., a UUID, job ID, or trace ID).
    --         Some pipelines may instead use job_id with the same
    --         semantics; readers SHOULD treat run_id/job_id as
    --         equivalent labels for the producing run.
    --
    --     - job_id: TEXT
    --         Alternative to run_id for systems that use job-centric
    --         identifiers. When both run_id and job_id are present,
    --         they SHOULD refer to the same logical execution.
    --
    --     - model: TEXT
    --         Name of the model used when the event content is derived
    --         from or transformed by a model (e.g., "gpt-4.1-mini",
    --         "timeline_summarizer_v2"). For non-model-based events
    --         this field MAY be omitted.
    --
    --     - tool: TEXT
    --         Name of the tool, service, or application component that
    --         invoked the model or performed the transformation
    --         (e.g., "clinical_notes_ingestor", "imaging_parser").
    --
    --     - confidence: NUMERIC or TEXT
    --         Confidence score or qualitative label associated with the
    --         event content (e.g., 0.92, "high"). Writers SHOULD
    --         document their own scale; readers MUST treat this as
    --         advisory only.
    --
    --     - input_hash: TEXT
    --         Hash or fingerprint of the input payload used to generate
    --         this event, useful for deduplication and auditing.
    --
    --     - extra: JSONB OBJECT
    --         Free-form extension map for pipeline-specific provenance
    --         details. Keys inside extra are not part of the stable
    --         contract and may vary by writer.
    --
    -- Contract notes:
    --   - The meta column itself remains unconstrained JSONB to
    --     preserve backward compatibility. No database-level
    --     constraints or NOT NULL requirements are added for
    --     meta.provenance or any of its fields; validation is enforced
    --     in application code.
    --   - For NEW events, writers SHOULD populate meta.provenance with
    --     at least the required fields above. For legacy rows, absence
    --     of meta.provenance (or partial population) MUST NOT break
    --     readers or writers.
    --   - Retrieval paths (API handlers, services, background jobs,
    --     summarizers, gap retrieval, and patient state builders)
    --     MUST treat meta as an opaque JSONB blob and return it
    --     verbatim, without dropping or reshaping the meta.provenance
    --     block. Any intentional redaction MUST be narrowly scoped and
    --     documented in code comments.
    --   - This contract is logical/application-level only; it does not
    --     change the physical schema of ehr.patient_timeline.
    --   - This comment block is the server-side mirror of the
    --     canonical provenance documentation in
    --     database/schemas/ehr_timeline.sql. Any changes to the
    --     documented keys, types, or semantics MUST be applied in both
    --     places and kept textually aligned where possible so that
    --     database, server schema, and Python helpers all share a
    --     single, consistent contract for meta.provenance.
    --
    -- Example meta with provenance (illustrative only):
    --   {
    --     "provenance": {
    --       "source_system": "ehr",
    --       "source_table": "encounters",
    --       "ingest_pipeline": "etl.ehr.v1",
    --       "writer_version": "1.2.3",
    --       "original_id": "enc-12345",
    --       "created_at": "2025-12-17T20:25:26.406538+00:00",
    --       "updated_at": "2025-12-17T20:25:26.406538+00:00",
    --       "run_id": "run-9f8c7d6e",
    --       "model": "gpt-4.1-mini",
    --       "tool": "timeline_summarizer_v2",
    --       "confidence": 0.93,
    --       "input_hash": "sha256:abcd1234...",
    --       "extra": {
    --         "note_section": "assessment_and_plan"
    --       }
    --     }
    --   }
);

-- Basic indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_patient_timeline_patient_ts
    ON ehr.patient_timeline (patient_id, ts DESC);

-- ANN index: only if pgvector is installed (it should be, since rag_corpus uses it)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS patient_timeline_embedding_idx
ON ehr.patient_timeline
USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
WITH (
    m = 16,
    ef_construction = 200
);

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ontology;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

-- Core diseases table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ontology.orphanet_diseases (
  orpha_code   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                -- canonical "ORPHA:803"
  orpha_num    INTEGER,                         -- numeric 803
  name         TEXT NOT NULL,
  disorder_type TEXT,
  definition   TEXT,
  status       TEXT,
  expert_link  TEXT,
  updated_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orphanet_diseases_name_trgm
  ON ontology.orphanet_diseases USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops);

-- Synonyms: make nullable fields NOT NULL with default '' so they can be in PK
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ontology.orphanet_synonyms (
  orpha_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ontology.orphanet_diseases(orpha_code) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  synonym    TEXT NOT NULL,
  lang       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  scope      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (orpha_code, synonym, lang, scope)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orphanet_synonyms_syn_trgm
  ON ontology.orphanet_synonyms USING gin (synonym gin_trgm_ops);

-- External refs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ontology.orphanet_external_refs (
  orpha_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ontology.orphanet_diseases(orpha_code) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source     TEXT NOT NULL,
  ref        TEXT NOT NULL,
  url        TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (orpha_code, source, ref)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orphanet_xref_source_ref_idx
  ON ontology.orphanet_external_refs (source, ref);

-- Gene links: make association_type NOT NULL with default '' for PK
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ontology.orphanet_gene_links (
  orpha_code       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ontology.orphanet_diseases(orpha_code) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  gene_symbol      TEXT NOT NULL,
  entrez_id        TEXT,
  ensembl_id       TEXT,
  association_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  inheritance      TEXT,
  evidence         TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (orpha_code, gene_symbol, association_type)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orphanet_gene_symbol_idx
  ON ontology.orphanet_gene_links (gene_symbol);

-- Phenotype links (HPO)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ontology.orphanet_phenotype_links (
  orpha_code  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ontology.orphanet_diseases(orpha_code) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  hpo_id      TEXT NOT NULL,      -- e.g. HP:0001250
  hpo_label   TEXT,
  frequency   TEXT,
  diagnostic  BOOLEAN,
  negated     BOOLEAN,
  PRIMARY KEY (orpha_code, hpo_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orphanet_phenotype_hpo_idx
  ON ontology.orphanet_phenotype_links (hpo_id);
